mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_nutrient (id, user_id, universal_id, flag, ai_info_id, ai_task_id, calory, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sugar, sodium) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{universalId}, #{flag}, #{aiInfoId}, #{aiTaskId}, #{calory}, #{protein}, #{fat}, #{carbohydrate}, #{sugar}, #{sodium})
insert into ai_info(id, user_id, model, temperature, ai_type, ai_application) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{model}, #{temperature}, #{aiType}, #{aiApplication})

INSERT INTO ai_task (id, user_id, client_request_id, task_type, status, input_snapshot, attempt_count, max_attempts, create_time, version_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{inputSnapshot}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{createTime}, #{versionId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_task WHERE id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, queue_time = COALESCE(queue_time, #{queueTime}), start_time = COALESCE(start_time, #{startTime}), finish_time = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND client_request_id = #{clientRequestId} AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < #{startTime}) )

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'FAILED', worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND client_request_id = #{clientRequestId} AND attempt_count >= max_attempts AND version_id = #{versionId} AND ( status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < #{finishTime}) )

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < #{leaseUntil} AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_outbox (id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, tag, message_key, payload, schema_version, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time, version_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, #{tag}, #{messageKey}, #{payload}, #{schemaVersion}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetries}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{versionId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mq_outbox WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', update_time = #{updateTime}, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('NEW', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND version_id = #{versionId}

UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 'SENT', broker_message_id = #{brokerMessageId}, sent_time = #{sentTime}, update_time = #{sentTime}, last_error = NULL, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND version_id = #{versionId}

UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND version_id = #{versionId}

UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 'DEAD', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND version_id = #{versionId}

UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_retry_time = #{now}, last_error = 'SENDING_TIMEOUT_RECOVERED', update_time = #{now}, version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE status = 'SENDING' AND update_time < #{timeoutBefore}
UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'QUEUED', queue_time = COALESCE(queue_time, #{queueTime}), version_id = version_id + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'
